summary.finding: Thirty-two candidate identities have two independent retained lineages that establish the exact macOS version, public channel, displayed public ordinal or explicit sequence, and America/Los_Angeles appearance date. Eight candidates remain blocked because a second lineage is generic, derives the ordinal from a developer seed, cannot establish the proposed Pacific date, or directly conflicts on the date.

productionRecheck.finding: All twelve version parents exist, but no macOS publicBeta event exists in published production and none of the forty exact candidate identities is already present.

sourceReferenceAndLineageAudit.finding: Every candidate evidence reference resolves to a retained source record. Approval was based on claim-level proof, not source-record or publisher-family counts; supplemental retained sources were selected only where their captured text independently proved the missing field.
